source_binding: The final package race suites, lint, and policy checks bind all three committed files. The prose snapshot precedes two code-only guards on an absent-file retry. Documentation bytes and all source comments remain identical.
limits: The original capability test fails because private records have no checked removal operation under publication ownership. No existing automatic deletion defect is claimed.

CompareAndRemoveFileContext shares PublishFileContext native ownership. It checks expected content, private metadata, native file identity and access, and directory ownership before unlink. Legacy uncoordinated writers are not a supported collection participant.

The twelve focused race events cover changed content, matching removal, absent retry, active publisher refusal, visible removal with failed directory synchronization, reopen retry, empty content, nil expectation, cancellation, path traversal, reserved metadata, directory, symlink, and replaced-parent refusal. Counts include parent events.
The complete private-file package passes 116 race events on each Go toolchain without failures or skips. These toolchain runs repeat the same cases and are not 232 distinct tests.

A reported visible removal cannot be reversed by a later synchronization error. A retry of an absent record verifies its directory ownership and synchronizes the directory. No process-exit or power-loss qualification follows from injected synchronization failure.

Runtime reachability selection is not implemented by this primitive. The runtime must trace accepted history and pending publications while excluding input writers before selecting removal candidates.

The new operation does not enable automatic cleanup or collect generation objects. Object-store coordination, runtime collection, history retirement, twelve mapped subcases, full verification, required review, native CI, and merge remain open.
Native Windows and Linux execution remain unverified for this checkpoint. The local macOS symlink test passed without a skip.

The owner question about shared object-catalog coordination versus an S3-only coordination protocol is pending. No answer is inferred and no accepted architecture or CSP5 scope changed. Local filesystem work continues independently.
Five concurrent tooling edits remain outside the source commit. Final task qualification must use its final committed module graph.
The final canonical prose check passes. Source snapshots separate the concurrent tooling edits from six owned documentation files. Task criteria, scope, invariants, and the goal remain unchanged.

existing_boundaries: publishInputsWithRemovals holds publicationMu and providerRetentionMu across staging, catalog acceptance, and retained-input completion.
inputChanges.stage records source, provider, manual-history, and removal references. Accepted manual history retains batch and observation references in publication-inputs.
loadInputPublication distinguishes prepared or committed pending inputs from an idle marker. Collection must preserve its exact references.

runGroup in runtime/refresh.go joins cancellation and shutdown. The existing execute method applies update policy and refresh ownership, so collection must not inherit forbidden catalog acquisition as a side effect.
CompareAndRemoveFileContext checks one record only. Its native writer lock does not protect the runtime reference graph. The runtime owns that protection.
